forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見上|みあ}げていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To raise one's eyes to look at something higher than oneself, such as the sky, a tall building, or a person's face.

definitions.gloss: to admire, to look up to
definitions.explanation: To regard someone or something with respect and admiration (figurative use).

examples.japanese: ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げた。
examples.english: I looked up at the sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I am looking up at the stars.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げた。
examples.english: The child looked up at the father's face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ビル→ビル：01500_biru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}く→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I look up at tall buildings, my neck starts to hurt.
When I looked up at the cherry tree, petals were dancing in the wind.

examples.notes: [Note: {見上|みあ}げたもの is a set expression meaning 'something admirable']

examples.japanese: {見上|みあ}げた⟦{根性|こんじょう}→根性：19215_konjou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦あんなに→あんなに：01876_annani⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{見上|みあ}げた⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Working that hard is really admirable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦とは→とは：noentry⟧、{見上|みあ}げた⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Supporting a family alone — what an admirable person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見上|みあ}げた⟦もの→もの：02259_mono⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The way she helps people in trouble is truly admirable.

notes:
{見上|みあ}げる is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) meaning to look upward at something.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to see) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise) → to raise one's gaze

ASPECT (ている):
{見上|みあ}げて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of looking up.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げる (look up at the sky)
- ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げる (look up at the stars)
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見上|みあ}げる (look up at someone's face)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見下|みお}ろす→見下ろす：04569_miorosu⟧: opposite meaning (to look down at)
- ⟦{仰|あお}ぐ→仰ぐ：11454_aogu⟧: more literary/formal way to express looking up
